## Workflow outcome

Name the affected workflow and user-visible result.

## Permissions and contracts

List roles/permissions, endpoints, mutations, validation, and shared contracts affected.

## Verification

List exact checks and success, failure, forbidden, conflict, and retry evidence.

## Risk and rollback

Describe sensitive data, destructive actions, migration/cutover risk, and rollback.

## Checklist

- [ ] Server authorization remains authoritative.
- [ ] Pending, success, validation, forbidden, conflict, failure, and retry states are covered.
- [ ] Keyboard, focus, zoom, responsive, and long bilingual content are covered.
- [ ] No secret or unpublished content leaked into logs or fixtures.
